youtube_title: Jesus... I Can't Remember The Last Time I Did Something For Me | Matthew 11:28 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... I can't remember the last time I did something just for me. 😔

His week belongs to work, family and everyone's problems, and he cannot remember the last hour that was his.

He: Jesus... I can't remember the last time I did something just for me. 😔

He: Work, family calls, helping everyone. My whole week belongs to other people.

Jesus: You gave away your Sunday, your evenings, even your lunch break. I saw every piece you handed out.

He: Isn't that what a good son does? What a good friend does?

Jesus: It is. But you didn't leave yourself a single seat in your own week, and even I rested.

He: I feel guilty resting when everyone around me needs something.

Jesus: Rest isn't stealing from them. A poured-out cup cannot pour again. Sit with Me tonight.

He: I honestly don't know what I'd even do with an hour that was mine.

Jesus: Then start small. One hour, no phone, no favours. Just you and Me remembering who you are.

Jesus: The world will not fall apart if you rest tonight. I'm holding it.

"“Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest."
Matthew 11:28 (BSB)

Then start small. One hour, no phone, no favours. Just you and Me remembering who you are.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered from Scripture.

When did you last do something just for you? 🙏

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
